pb-lists.caption: Select the programme first to see its beneficiary lists.

pb-eligibility.caption: Choose the programme whose eligibility rules you want to inspect.

pb-entitlements.caption: Choose the programme whose entitlement rules you want to inspect.

pb-benefits.caption: Choose the programme whose benefit codes you want to inspect.

pb-programme-benefits.caption: Choose the programme whose programme benefits you want to inspect.

pb-programme-analytics.caption: Choose the programme, cycle and map measure before reading the totals.

payment-report.caption: Refresh report retrieves the latest status. Download report saves a copy for follow-up.

approval-input.caption: The approval area has a comment box and a supporting-document field. Use the controls available at your assigned stage.

di-history.caption: In Transfers, use Refresh history to update the list or New import to start a batch.

di-expected.caption: Expand Expected columns to compare your spreadsheet headings with the selected source.

di-file.caption: Choose File opens the file picker. The supported file types and limits appear below it.

di-fetch.caption: Fetch and validate reads the CSV from the selected connection.

di-access.caption: The access screen identifies who prepares a batch and who can review it.

di-partial-rows.caption: In Reconcile records, read the status beside each row. Here one row was logged, one was excluded and one has no receipt.

di-saved-without-log.caption: The receipt says the Registry saved the rows and their log is missing. Keep the original Registry reference.

di-receipt-log-restored.caption: A restored receipt confirms the previously saved rows and keeps the original Registry reference.

di-received-with-error.caption: Here the job failed after the Registry logged all included rows. Keep the receipt for investigation.

di-activity.caption: Activity records when the receipt log was restored. Use the event to follow up the same batch.

di-unconfirmed.caption: When delivery is uncertain, refresh the existing receipt to check what happened.

di-returned.caption: Returned for correction identifies the batch the operator needs to reopen.

di-approved.caption: The Approved status and row totals identify a batch ready for the operator to transfer.

di-test.caption: Expand Test mapping with sample values to preview how a row will be translated.

exclude-row.caption: Open the flagged row, compare the source values, then use Exclude this row from the transfer when appropriate.

map-fields.caption: Map each spreadsheet column to its Registry column. The transform and required-value settings apply to that field.

source-mapping.caption: In Sources and mappings, choose a source before checking the destination and input method.

find-household.caption: Use Filters or the search box above the household results.

find-person.caption: Use the search box above the individual records to find the person you need.

household-form.caption: The household intake form groups consent, members, living conditions and income into sections.

individual-form.caption: Individual registration has sections for demographics and identification.

history.caption: In Version History, choose the section and version to compare earlier values.

review-actions.caption: Enter the reviewer message and choose the decision that matches the evidence.

membership.caption: Household Member Details shows the people linked to this household.

dwelling.caption: Housing and basic services shows the recorded dwelling and construction details.

offline.caption: Open Offline field capture in the Registry to find the setup instructions for your assigned device.

odk-menu.caption: In ODK Collect, Drafts holds unfinished interviews. Ready to send and Sent let you check delivery.

resubmit.caption: Read the confirmation before submitting the corrected record for review.

directory.caption: On All platform services, search for a service or browse the cards under People and households.

staff-sign-in.caption: On the staff sign-in screen, enter the email for your assigned account and select Log in.

rg-accuracy-confirm.caption: Review the household details before checking the accuracy declaration.

rg-consent-answer.caption: Record the respondent’s answer. Choosing No tells the interviewer to stop.

rg-survey-sponsor.caption: Choose the organisation that commissioned this survey.

rg-survey-respondent.caption: Enter the name of the person answering the interview.

rg-state.caption: Choose the state or FCT first, then the local government area and ward.

rg-latitude.caption: Enter the latitude in the labelled field and longitude in its companion field.

rg-gps-accuracy.caption: Record the accuracy reported by the device in metres.

rg-location-time.caption: Enter the time the device captured the reading, in UTC.

rg-location-source.caption: Record where the location reading came from.

rg-enumeration-area.caption: Use Locality / EA Code for the assigned enumeration area.

registries.caption: The Household register card shows the reference, review status and synchronisation status.

complaints.caption: Select the complaint reason and use Submit complaint to send it.

notifications.caption: The unread count and the action beside each notice help you keep track of messages.

news.caption: Search by keyword or select the article language.

accounts.caption: Accounts identifies the household whose payment-account mapping you are viewing.

applications.caption: My Applications lists each application, its status and its reference. Keep the reference for follow-up.

apply.caption: Find the programme in All Programs and use the Apply button on its row.

benefits.caption: My Benefits shows approved entitlements when available. The link below the empty list opens My Applications.

staff-tiles.caption: Select the tile for the application you need in the Staff Portal.

iam-apps.caption: The Applications list shows the registered application name and description.

providers.caption: Login Providers lists the configured sign-in connections and authentication methods.

policy.caption: Open a policy version to see its stages and the rules for assigning each review.

request-filter.caption: In Requests, use the status filter to narrow the workflow list.

delegation.caption: New delegation asks for the delegator, the delegate and the period of the assignment.

deliveries.caption: Webhook Deliveries has a status filter for callbacks to the originating application.

audit.caption: Use the Audit Log filters to narrow the recorded actions.

partners.caption: The Requests list groups onboarding and key rotation requests by status.

partner-review.caption: The partner detail view keeps keys and the event history together for review.

partner-onboard.caption: Start the onboarding request with the partner ID, name and organisation.

levels.caption: Manage Geo Levels shows the country, state or FCT, and local government area levels.

areas.caption: Expand Nigeria and select a state. The table shows local government areas under that state.

dashboards.caption: The Dashboards section in Superset Home links to dashboards available to your account.

datasets.caption: The Datasets view lists the sources available to the reporting workspace.

library-editor.caption: In Create guidance, set the service and audience before entering the title and purpose.

library-assistant.caption: Select the service, audience and workflow stage, then enter the question.

library-version.caption: The version heading identifies the saved edition of an article.

help-panel.caption: In Contextual help, Open documentation guide leads to the instructions for this role and screen.

case-queue.caption: Household work queue shows the status and next step. Open the case marked Awaiting verification.

case-roster.caption: Household members identifies the household head and the other people on the submitted record.

jos.caption: Use the Jos Family Support navigation to follow a sample household through the programme.

field-visit.caption: In the sample household visit, use the section tabs to move between Area, Home, Needs and Review.

phase-grievance.caption: In Grievance intake, select a participant and category before creating the fictional case.

atlas.caption: Choose a territorial measure and area. The map and the neighbouring summary show the same selection.

state-map.caption: Use Select state / FCT to read the count and share for one area.

record-points.caption: Select Household records and use Show household location points to display reported locations.

rg-submit.caption: Save Draft keeps work for later. Submit sends it for review.

live-consent-manager-partners.caption: Partner policies shows which partner and sharing policy are linked.

live-consent-manager-approvals.caption: Approvals lists policy changes waiting for the assigned reviewer.

live-consent-manager-decisions.caption: Decisions lists recorded consent checks for review.

live-partner-management-directory.caption: In Partners, compare the organisation and status before opening its record.

di-partial.caption: The receipt gives the ingested count. Use Refresh Registry receipt to check progress before following up.

rg-member-relationship.caption: Choose how the member is related to the household head.

rg-member-age.caption: When the date of birth is unknown, enter the estimated age in completed years.

rg-member-nin.caption: Enter the 11-digit NIN in its own field when available.

rg-member-banking.caption: The bank account number field takes 10 digits. The BVN has its own field.

rg-health-response.caption: Record each response for the member whose details are open.

rg-monthly-income.caption: Read the reporting period before entering the household amount.

rg-income-source.caption: Choose the source of income reported by the household.

rg-household-shock.caption: Select the applicable shocks after the household reports a shock in the past three years.

rg-insurance-status.caption: Record whether anyone in this household has health insurance.

rg-asset-response.caption: Record the answer to the ownership question before filling any follow-up fields.

rg-crops-grown.caption: Choose Yes to see the follow-up crop list, or No when the household grows no crops.

case-reason.caption: Read What needs correction before changing the returned household record.

case-edit.caption: Update the returned household, then use Save correction & resubmit to send the same case back to review.

case-checks.caption: Check the household details, whether the correction was addressed, and what registration approval covers.

case-confirm.caption: Read the confirmation before connecting the registration to the registries.

citizen-members.caption: Member 1 is the applicant and household head. Add the other household members below.

citizen-household.caption: Start with Household details. Enter the household name and select its state or FCT.

live-g2p-library.caption: Search guidance in the Knowledge Library, then narrow the results to your service and audience.

live-g2p-analytics.caption: Select the state or programme and check the report time before comparing totals.

pay-67-counts.caption: In this example, one instruction was reconciled and one reversal was recorded. Check the bank statement for the same instruction.

pay-71-counts.caption: This example has two declared instructions and one reversal. Check the individual outcomes against the statement.

pay-70-0-exception.caption: A reversal amount exception means a later statement supplied a conflicting amount. Finance checks the two entries.

pay-67-1-dispatch.caption: Sponsor bank dispatch status shows the state of the batch handoff.

pay-67-1-resolution.caption: FA resolution status shows whether the financial address was resolved for dispatch.

pay-progress.caption: View payment progress opens the workflow for the submitted list.

detail-programme-detail.caption: Open Programme information and use Edit programme settings when your role allows it.

detail-tabs.caption: Use the tabs inside the selected programme to move between its settings, rules and lists.

detail-eligibility.caption: Eligibility rules lists the criteria used for this programme.

detail-lists.caption: Beneficiary lists opens the processing records for the selected programme.

detail-benefits.caption: Benefit codes shows the benefits available in this programme.

detail-programme-benefits.caption: Programme benefits shows which benefits are assigned to this programme.

detail-entitlements.caption: Entitlement rules connects a benefit with its assigned quantity.

detail-enrollment-workflow.caption: Open an enrollment list to inspect its calculation, evidence and approval history.

detail-disbursement-workflow.caption: Use Disbursement lists and workflow to find the list for this cycle.

button-approve-batch.caption: The independent reviewer uses Approve batch after checking the rows.

button-return-batch.caption: Use Return for correction when the operator needs to change the batch.

button-request.caption: Send for approval passes the prepared batch to an independent reviewer.

button-new-csv.caption: Use Fetch a new CSV only when you intend to start a separate import.

button-transfer.caption: Transfer to Registry sends the rows from the approved batch.

button-download-audit.caption: Download audit report keeps the batch history for follow-up.

button-logged.caption: Expand the row in Reconcile records to see its Registry receipt status.

odk-projects.caption: Open the assigned project to find its forms.

odk-users.caption: Web Users shows account administration. Project access is managed for the assigned collection work.

odk-audits.caption: In Server Audit Logs, use the action and date filters to find an event.

odk-analytics.caption: The Usage Reporting tab displays the server reporting settings.

registry-settings.caption: Registry details identifies the configuration workspace for this Registry.

review-queue.caption: In Intake Form Submission, use the status filters to find a task awaiting a decision.

change-tasks.caption: In Change Requests, use the status filters to find the request you need.

staff-roles.caption: Staff and roles shows the Registry staff configuration available to an administrator.

pb-login.caption: Use the Email and Password fields on the PBMS sign-in screen.

incoming.caption: The incoming messages list lets staff inspect records moving through the Registry integration.

outgoing.caption: The outgoing messages list lets staff inspect records moving through the Registry integration.

flow-access.caption: Use Find staff to locate the existing account before assigning its programme role.

flow-history.caption: Each history entry identifies the role, decision and list revision. Compare the revision before acting.

flow-comment.caption: Use the comment field to record the context for the current submission.

flow-stats.caption: Status and Revision identify the list version. NOB is the beneficiary count. Total NGN is the list amount in naira.

flow-dates.caption: Use the four separate dates for the registration and disbursement windows.

flow-schedule.caption: Check the approved enrolment cycle before entering the scheduled disbursement date.

button-return-note.caption: Describe the error in Reason for returning this batch so the operator can correct the same batch.

sandbox-conditionality.caption: In Submit fictional evidence, choose the household and monthly period for the attendance record.

sandbox-readiness.caption: Read the scope of the checks under Verified engineering results before interpreting the figures.

partner-simulation.caption: In Start a demonstration, choose a scenario to follow a fictional transfer.

household-programmes.caption: Use the Household programmes tab to check the programme entries linked to the published household.

correction.caption: A returned list shows its current revision, status and beneficiary entries for correction.

sandbox-field.caption: Choose the fictional household and delivery details in the field demonstration.

public-portal.caption: The public portal groups programme information, news and guidance for visitors.

state-failed.caption: Ingestion needs attention. Use this batch reference to check the receipt and row evidence.

state-queued.caption: Queued at Registry means that the Registry accepted the batch for processing.

state-retry.caption: Ready to retry identifies the batch to refer to the authorised operator.

state-sending.caption: Submitting to Registry means the transfer is in progress. Keep the batch reference.

state-review.caption: Awaiting approval identifies a batch that still needs review.

button-retry.caption: The authorised operator can select Retry transfer after resolving the reported issue.
